summary: Scott's October 26, 2023 statement centered empathy on families in Israel while omitting Palestinian victims in Gaza, an Israel-centric framing. In late November, after Palestinian students were shot in Burlington, he offered support to the local Muslim community, acknowledging the conflict's local impact.
